response.content:
Aspirin lookup and MolDesign calculation completed — no case created and no docking performed as requested.

**PubChem (CID 2244, Aspirin):**
- SMILES returned: `CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O`
- Source: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/2244
- Properties available: Formula C9H8O4, MW 180.16, XLogP 1.2, TPSA 63.6, HBD 1, HBA 4

**MolDesign / RDKit 2025.09.6 calculated on EXACTLY that SMILES:**
- Input SMILES: `CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O` → canonical `CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O`
- Identity check: `same` (RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES verifier, PubChem CID 2244 confirmed)
- Results: mw 180.16, logp 1.31 (Crippen.MolLogP), tpsa 63.6 (Ertl 2000, includeSandP=False), hbd 1 (Lipinski NHOHCount), hba 4 (Lipinski NOCount), rot_bonds 2, heavy_atoms 13, rings 1
- Variants also returned: tpsa_incl_s_p = 63.6 (includeSandP=True, identical here as no S/P), hba_rdkit_num_h_acceptors = 3 (CalcNumHBA SMARTS-based)

**Comparison (shown in interface table):**
- MW, TPSA, HBD match exactly (180.16, 63.6, 1).
- LogP: PubChem XLogP 1.2 vs MolDesign Crippen LogP 1.31 — different descriptors/methods as documented (PubChem XLogP vs RDKit Crippen), not directly interchangeable.
- HBA: PubChem 4 matches MolDesign Lipinski NOCount 4; MolDesign also provides alternative definition CalcNumHBA = 3. PubChem notes its HBA uses a 1997 classification whose detailed rules for this molecule were not verified here.
- TPSA: Both 63.6, but definitions can differ (PubChem TPSA vs RDKit Ertl with/without S/P) — here both variants give 63.6.

No docking result was invented or inferred.
